scientific_integrity: The statement and proof use a complete edge-coordinate identification, closed-range estimates and explicit infinite families of dual functionals; finite tests are supplementary and not treated as proofs.
scientific_limitations: Requires local finiteness, infinitude and leaflessness; only Fredholm essential spectrum; older equivalent representations remain possible; no independent audit.
title: Fredholm end-count dichotomy for parent composition on tree Lipschitz spaces
